'''''Observations on a Visit to Tear''''' is a book left behind when a group of [[Black Ajah]] fled the [[White Tower]]. It was used as a taunt and bait to lure [[Nynaeve al'Meara]], [[Elayne Trakand]], and [[Egwene al'Vere]] to follow the Black sisters to [[Tear]].{{ref/book|3|26}}
